summary: Add content-addressed validated-state evidence reuse, reproducible host capability facts, and revision-bound isolated local execution so unchanged evidence can be reused safely and deterministic long-tail work can run against exact snapshots.

candidates.rationale: User authorized the validated-state fingerprint and Ornith/local-execution architecture. The implementation reuses Git/content identity, keeps volatile evidence nonreusable, binds verification to exact tested revisions, isolates mutation workers, and preserves no-auto-merge/no-authority boundaries.

applied_changes.description: Added Evidence Reuse and Local Execution Plane protocols/policies/tools/tests, local host-fact persistence, snapshot regression jobs, stale-success classification, isolated worker handoffs, exclusive-scope collision protection, interaction bridges, and routed documentation.
